rdfs:label: controller
rdfs:comment: The entity (identified by a DID or URL) authorised to make changes to a DID document, or the entity a verification method belongs to — not necessarily whoever holds a given private key.
notes: Often the DID itself controls its own Document (self-sovereign). Multi-party setups (custodial wallets, organisational DIDs) point `controller` at a different entity. Verifiers consult `controller` to know who's authoritative for the document, e.g. when validating updates or rotation events.

history.note: Comment corrected: controller is the entity authorised to change the DID document, not necessarily the private-key holder.
